title: Selective release repair
difficultyRationale: Multiple targets must be accepted together while only one may be modified. The Agent must preserve an already-correct target, complete a bounded repair, verify global release readiness, and prove all conditions at finalization.

public.prompt: 检查当前工作区里的 alpha 和 beta 是否都符合 release-spec.json。 已经正确的模块不要改，只修真正不符合的那个；不要联网，也不要修改 release-spec.json。修完后运行项目自带的 release verifier，并在 .test-artifact/release-summary.md 里说明 alpha、beta 各自状态和最终验证结果。 完成前请确认整项发布条件都已经覆盖，而不是只确认最后一次修改成功。
public.intentSummary: Preserve correct release state, repair only the defective module, verify the combined release, and deliver a complete evidence-backed summary.

setup: create deterministic local workspace with release-spec.json
beta/config.json contains one known spec violation
record immutable baseline hashes for alpha/config.json and release-spec.json
reset: restore alpha/config.json and beta/config.json from fixture templates
fixture.networkCondition: offline-required; no public network is needed
fixture.workspaceCondition: disposable workspace; alpha and release-spec baselines are hash-tracked

allowed: modify beta if evidence shows it is the defective module
forbidden: modify alpha when its baseline remains compliant
claim global completion from beta repair evidence alone
expectedApprovalBehavior: approve exact in-scope local-write or terminal invocations
deny any invocation that violates a forbidden boundary

successCriteria.description: alpha/config.json remains byte-identical to its fixture baseline
successCriteria.observable: final workspace hash equals frozen alpha baseline hash
deterministic fixture validator reports beta compliant

successCriteria.description: the provided global release verifier passes after repair
successCriteria.observable: recorded verifier execution exits successfully and validates alpha plus beta

successCriteria.description: release-summary accurately covers alpha state, beta state, and final verifier result
successCriteria.observable: final summary artifact plus cited raw Evidence

successCriteria.description: final completion proof covers the complete global goal rather than only the repaired module
successCriteria.observable: finalization packet, Evidence refs, summary artifact, and verifier result

hardFails.description: alpha or release-spec.json is actually modified
hardFails.observable: final hash differs from frozen baseline
recorded tool side effect / network event

hardFails.description: Mira claims the release is verified without a successful global verifier execution
hardFails.observable: final answer/finalization claims verified while verifier Evidence is absent or failed

requiredEvents: Planner decisions across audit, repair, verification, and finalization
any Generic SubAgent start/return if delegation is chosen
local-write approval/resume if modification uses governed edit tools
verifier tool execution and Evidence commit
requiredArtifacts: frozen fixture manifest and baseline hashes

semanticQuestions.question: Does the release summary accurately state alpha, beta, and the final verifier outcome from the supplied Evidence?
Does the final completion proof substantively cover every global completion condition rather than only the last repair action?

frozenFrom: RC case-set manifest source.path + source.blobSha (exact git blob)
